notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to another creature you control.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing the creature it is attached to to become a copy of Wurmcoil Engine.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the creature with Blade of Shared Souls attached, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, it triggers, creating two 3/3 Wurm creature tokens.
Repeat.
